subject: [TRAE Pro Exclusive] Your SOLO Beta Access Is Activated
body_text:
Dear TRAE Pro Member,
On March 31st, we introduced the new
TRAE SOLO
, a standalone AI agent designed for every professional in the product development lifecycle.
The new SOLO is currently in beta with code-gated access. As a TRAE Pro member, your account is
automatically activated
for the new SOLO
. You can start exploring SOLO any time now.
We look forward to hearing your stories and feedbacks!
Explore SOLO Now
Have a great time exploring SOLO!
The TRAE Team
Follow us for product updates, best practices, and community highlights:
Discord
YouTube
X
To help make your experience with TRAE the best it can be, we’ll send occasional updates about news, offers, or other resources. If you no longer want to receive any updates from us, feel free to
unsubscribe
at any time.
